subject_definitions:
<Picture 1> is the authority for the presenter: the same young woman, her face, long dark brown hair, cream knit cardigan over a white top, and the bright apartment dining area behind her.
<Picture 2> is the authority for the product: a round kraft-paper yogurt cup with a white front label showing an orange-and-green mango illustration, holding thick pale-yellow clotted-cream yogurt, eaten with a wooden spoon.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: identity_preserved. Her face, hair, outfit and the room carry over; her pose and framing follow this shot.
<Picture 2>: attribute_transfer. The cup's kraft-paper material, shape, white label layout, mango illustration, the pale-yellow thick yogurt and the wooden spoon carry over. Its beige cloth backdrop, the fruit pieces and its close-up framing do not.

detailed_description:
A vertical selfie-style medium shot at eye level, framing the presenter from the waist up at the dining table. Behind her on the table sits an open white foam delivery box packed with rows of identical cups from <Picture 2>. She holds one opened cup from <Picture 2> up beside her face, label toward the lens, and says casually and a little quickly, like chatting with a friend, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 最近嘴馋得不行，我都没怎么敢出去买甜品，</d> then scoops a spoonful of the thick yogurt with the wooden spoon, takes a bite, and while still holding the cup up to camera says, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 就拿这个杨枝甘露酸奶当下午茶。</d>

soundscape: her clear close-mic Mandarin voice, a soft scrape of the wooden spoon in the cup, quiet apartment room tone. No music.

No subtitles, captions, watermarks or extra text anywhere; the only printing is the label already shown on the cup in <Picture 2>, kept stable. No other brands. No extra fingers, no distorted hands, no duplicated cups in her hand. No morphing, no cuts, no camera movement beyond slight handheld sway.

detailed_description:
A vertical selfie-style medium shot at eye level, framing her from the waist up at the dining table. She sets her cup down, turns slightly and reaches into the open white foam delivery box on the table beside her, which is packed neatly with twelve identical sealed cups from <Picture 2> in rows. She lifts one sealed cup out and holds it toward the lens, then sweeps her other hand over the full box to show how many there are, speaking brightly, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 六块八毛九澳币一杯，到手一大箱十二杯，</d> stressing the last words, then with a quick happy grin says faster, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 我赶紧囤了一大箱。</d>

soundscape: her clear close-mic Mandarin voice, light rustle of the foam box and cups touching, quiet room tone. No music.

No subtitles, captions, price tags, watermarks or extra text anywhere; the only printing is the cup label from <Picture 2>, kept stable on every cup. No other brands. No extra fingers, no distorted hands, the number of cups in the box stays constant. No morphing, no cuts, no camera movement beyond slight handheld sway.

subject_definitions:

<Picture 2> is the authority for the product label: the round kraft-paper cup with its white front label, the orange-and-green mango illustration, the orange UMALL mark, and the printed ingredients panel on the right side of the label.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: attribute_transfer. Only her hands, skin tone and cardigan sleeve carry over; her face is not in this shot.
<Picture 2>: fully_preserved for the label. Keep the label layout, mango illustration, UMALL mark and the ingredients panel exactly as shown, crisp and never garbled or re-lettered. Its spoon, fruit and backdrop do not carry over.

detailed_description:
A locked vertical close-up insert: her left hand holds one cup from <Picture 2> close to the lens so the white label fills most of the frame, the soft dining table blurred behind. Her off-screen voice speaks in a slower, reminding tone, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 你们在选的时候，一定要看好配料表，</d> as she turns the cup slightly so the ingredients panel faces the camera. Her right index finger comes in and taps the ingredients panel on one line, then slides down and taps a second line, while she names each one clearly, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 要选这种有芒果果泥、西柚果肉的。</d>

soundscape: her close off-screen Mandarin voice, a soft fingertip tap on paper for each item, quiet room tone. No music.

No subtitles, captions, watermarks or text other than the label already in <Picture 2>; the label must stay sharp and unchanged. No other brands. No extra fingers, no distorted hands or nails. No morphing, no cuts, no camera movement.

<Picture 2> is the authority for the product and its texture: the opened kraft-paper cup with the white mango label, the thick pale-yellow clotted-cream yogurt, and the wooden spoon lifting out one whole dense scoop that holds its rounded shape.

retention_analysis:
<Picture 1>: identity_preserved. Face, hair, outfit and room carry over.
<Picture 2>: attribute_transfer. The cup, label, wooden spoon, the yogurt's pale-yellow colour and its dense, scoopable texture that holds shape carry over. Its beige cloth backdrop and fruit pieces do not.

detailed_description:
A vertical selfie-style medium shot at eye level. She holds the opened cup from <Picture 2> up toward the lens with both hands, the wooden spoon standing in the thick yogurt, and says with delighted surprise, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 哇塞你看这个质地啊，</d> then slowly lifts the spoon out with one whole dense scoop that keeps its rounded shape, leaving a clear hollow in the yogurt surface that the camera can see, drawing out her words, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 哇，一挖一个坑啊，</d> and holds the scoop still above the cup for the lens, finishing warmly, (S1) <d>[Chinese] 就是杨枝甘露的味道。</d>

soundscape: her clear close-mic Mandarin voice, a soft thick suction sound as the scoop lifts out, quiet room tone. No music.

No subtitles, captions, watermarks or extra text anywhere; the only printing is the cup label from <Picture 2>, kept stable. No other brands. The scoop stays one intact piece, never dripping, splitting or vanishing. No extra fingers, no distorted hands or face. No morphing, no cuts, no camera movement beyond slight handheld sway.
